function asValue<T>(value: T): {} | null | undefined {
  return value;
}
type NonNullish = {};
type BroadValue = NonNullish | null | undefined | 'example';
function copy(value: unknown): BroadValue {
  return value;
}
const unknownValue: unknown = 42;
console.log(asValue(42), asValue(null), asValue(undefined));
console.log(copy(unknownValue), copy({ name: 'item' }));
const blank = {};
function makeBlank() { return {}; }
function blankValue(value: unknown): typeof blank | null | undefined { return value; }
function returnValue(value: unknown): ReturnType<typeof makeBlank> | null | undefined { return value; }
console.log(blankValue('blank'), returnValue(true));
